chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad al-Hannat, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about a slave girl shared between two men. One of them emancipated his share of her. When his partner saw that, he leapt upon the slave girl and had intercourse with her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who had intercourse with her shall be whipped with fifty lashes, and fifty lashes shall be deducted from his manumission, and half of her shall be free. And from the remaining half which was not emancipated, a tenth of her value shall be deducted if she is a virgin, and half of a tenth of her value if she is not a virgin. And she shall be compelled to work for the remainder.'

key_terms.تُسْتَسْعَى: she shall be compelled to work

ai.seo_question: What is the legal compensation and manumission process for a shared slave girl when one partner emancipates his share and the other has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the specific jurisprudence of partial manumission in a shared slave girl, where the non-emancipating partner's sexual act triggers a dual penalty: fifty lashes deducted from his remaining share and a financial valuation deducted from the girl's value. This ruling highlights the Shia legal distinction between virginity and non-virginity in determining compensation, ensuring the girl's continued servitude to offset the remaining debt after these deductions.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad Al Hanaat who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a slave girl between two men. One of them emancipated (liberated) his share of her. So when his partner saw that, he leapt upon the slave girl and fell upon her. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who fell upon her would be whipped with fifty lashes, and fifty lashes would be subtracted from him, and half of her happens to be free and there would be reduced from the remaining half which is not emancipated; and if she was a virgin, a tenth of her price, and if she was not a virgin, half of the tenth of her price, and she has to work with regards to the remainder’.
